name: The Bell-Keeper's House
story: Seventeen small bells, one for each founding family, and Hesta keeps them all: oiled, rehung, rung on the right days. Two of the seventeen are buried under the Long Table's foot. She still oils the hooks they hung from.
who_was_here: Her aunt, who taught her which bell is which by its note alone.
unique_object: seventeen hooks, fifteen of them holding a bell
